title: This was amazing!!...
text: This was amazing!! Everyone was friendly, and the live music was perfect. The sunset was spectacular, would go again!
author: Claire_D

title: A must do in Barcelona
text:
Incredible value for money. Just a wonderful experience. Live jazz music played by 2 very talented musicians as we sailed ( yes - real sails) over the calm waters. We  watched the sky change colours  by the moment and sunset was just magical.  Special family trip from 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 to celebrate husband’s 70th .

Just for info if you are mobility impaired, to board you climb down very steep steps ( same into toilet)  . Staff were a great help though as I’m currently in a CAM boot 🫣.
author: O539NCwendym

title: Great music and a fab sunset
text: A great trip across the water - amazing views, magnificent sunset all accompanied by 2 great jazz musicians - would highly recommend!
author: Jan_M

title: Great sunset
text: Great trip good saxophone 🎷 player. Great sunset
author: mikec0llinge

title: Very Enjoyable jazz cruise
text: Enjoyable catamaran cruise with wonderful jazz music. The crew was very friendly.
author: Resort63989758343

title: Pleasant evening with friends
text: A very pleasant evening in a catamaran, with live music. Drinks and snacks available for purchase. Me and my friends went with no expectations, and after spending all day walking the streets of Barcelona  (over 30k steps on a very hot day lol) it was a very nice way to unwind, relax, and just enjoy the boat trip. I’d say it was worth the money. Would definitely recommend and I would definitely do it again.
author: B5460UGeduardop

title: Tour good. Viator....lacking.
text: The tour operator was great. Their access to Viator information wasn't. They made it work for us, and worth it, but something should be done on Viator's end. Which port to be at, time, and MAKING SURE our names are on the roster, so we aren't treated like afterthoughts. AGAIN the tour operators were the heros of this day. Viator needs to do better.
author: Cassie_U

title: Excellent value nice...
text: Excellent value nice relaxed atmosphere with beautiful sunsets. Will definitely recommend and return.
author: Rebecca_W

title: A great way to spend an evening.
text: The cruise was fantastic. It was well organised and punctual, the staff were friendly and the musician was fabulous. Highly recommend - a lovely way to spend an evening.
author: Lu_S

title: Very friendly staff, nice...
text:
Very friendly staff, nice music.
The duration is perfect, not too long. Also the boat is not overcrowded.
